findings.text: The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-10-01 to 2027-01-01 without any quoted documentary evidence in the fix record; the source document explicitly shows 2026-10-01, so this is an unsupported data change even though it resolved the CMS rejection.

Requested effective date 2026-11-01 is earlier than both Part A and Part B effective dates of 2026-12-01, yet the case was accepted. The timeline contains no corrective change to the effective date or Medicare effective dates before acceptance.
